_comment: Copy to inbox/inbox.json and edit. source.type picks the mail backend; keep only the block you use. NO PLAINTEXT SECRETS IN THIS FILE: the IMAP password comes from the env var named by imap.password_env (secrets/env) or (macOS) the keychain item {service: imap.password_keychain_service, account: imap.user}; the Gmail API uses an OAuth client + token file under the in-tree secrets/ dir (paths relative to bidkit/ cwd, e.g. ../secrets/…), so a zip of the repo moves everything.

imap._comment: Backend A — plain IMAP (this machine). Gmail: enable IMAP and use an App Password (Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App passwords).

gmail_api._comment: Backend B — Gmail REST API with OAuth (the machine with Google API access). One-time: download a Desktop-app OAuth client JSON from Google Cloud, save it as secrets/gmail-oauth-client.json (credentials_file); then run from the bidkit/ dir `python3 -m bidkit.mail_gmail auth --cfg ../inbox/inbox.json`, which writes token_file (chmod 600). Paths are relative to the bidkit/ working dir (../secrets/…) so the whole tree is portable. Scope is gmail.readonly unless mark_seen is true (then gmail.modify; delete the token and re-auth if you flip it). query uses Gmail search syntax; `after:` is added automatically from since_days.

match._comment: A message is filed if (1) it is from a from_trust sender (solicitation SOURCES whose subjects lack RFP/RFQ words — WEBS, FGA, bid-notification services), OR (2) its subject contains any subject_any term as a whole word (case-insensitive), OR (3) its body contains any body_any term. from_deny always wins; if from_allow is non-empty only those senders are considered (a restrictive gate, unlike from_trust which is additive).

portal_autofetch._comment: After filing a NEW opportunity, bin/bid-inbox.sh can run `bidkit.portal fetch` on its links (needs playwright + a logged-in profile; see inbox/portals.example.json). Off by default: a browser launching from cron is a bigger step than filing email. Enable here or with PORTAL_AUTOFETCH=1 in the environment.
